stories.title: 250 bovins périssent dans un incendie à Palézieux

en.title: 250 cattle die in farm fire at Palézieux
en.summary: A fire at a farm in Palézieux destroyed a barn and killed or led to the euthanasia of approximately 250 animals, mainly calves. No human injuries were reported.

stories.title: Des centaines de bovins tués dans l'incendie d'une grande ferme à Palézieux (VD)

en.title: Hundreds of cattle killed in fire at large farm in Palézieux (VD)
en.summary: A fire at a farm in Palézieux on Saturday evening killed 250 animals with no human casualties. The fire was brought under control Sunday morning, and the cause remains unknown.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - Die neuen Herren der Finanzmärkte: «KI-Agenten können die Notenbanken in die Enge treiben», sagt der Princeton-Professor Markus Brunnermeier

en.title: INTERVIEW - The new masters of financial markets: "AI agents can corner central banks," says Princeton professor Markus Brunnermeier
en.summary: Autonomous AI systems are gaining power in financial markets, but their decision-making processes remain opaque. Economist Markus Brunnermeier warns this opacity poses risks to financial stability.

stories.title: Er wirkte blass und distanziert. Trotzdem hatte der neue Apple-Chef John Ternus einen guten ersten Auftritt

en.title: He appeared pale and distant. Still, new Apple CEO John Ternus had a good first appearance
en.summary: John Ternus, known for Apple's high-margin hardware, made his debut as CEO by presenting a foldable iPhone, marking a successful first public appearance despite his reserved demeanor.

stories.title: Die Spekulanten werden die Entschlossenheit von US-Finanzminister Scott Bessent testen

en.title: Speculators will test the resolve of US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent
en.summary: Former hedge fund manager Scott Bessent challenged investors this week to bet against his market interventions, a stance that could lead to significant consequences.

stories.title: Bitcoin feiert ein Comeback – oder handelt es sich bloss um ein Strohfeuer?

en.title: Bitcoin celebrates a comeback – or is it just a flash in the pan?
en.summary: Bitcoin's price has risen sharply in a short period, with analysts considering two very different scenarios for what may happen next.
